title: Scout mo ƴiiƴam mum
intro: E nder laamu ngu gooto rokki laamu e dow henndu, e tagooje ɗe njiyataa, e tagooje asamaan, tergal gootal tokosal, yaawngal majjii e darɗe — tan ko warde e peeñɗi baawɗi waylude ngonka leñol woɗɗungol. Ooɗoo humpitiiɗo gite laaɓɗe, addii goonga ɗo majjere ƴellitii. Hol ko ngonmi?
clues: Mi golliima e ñaawirdu ɗo yimɓe, tagooje ɗe njiyataa, e tagooje asamaan njaabotoo laamɗo gooto ganndo, yamiroowo henndu nduu tigi.
Mi woppaani e posto am ko juuti, tikkere laamɗo oo fodaama so mi waawaa rokkude daliilu weltinoowo.
Miin ko mi tagoore tokosere dogdu, ganndiraaɗo gite tiiɗɗe, kadi sifaa am teddinaama e innde toownde e nder kelle wahyu.
Nde ngartu mi, mi addii kabaaru leydi woɗɗundi ɗo yimɓe cujji naange, wumɓe tagɗo kammu e leydi.
Mi tawii debbo ina laami laamu mawngu, ina jooɗii e jappeere mawnde, nde meeɗaa anndude goonga.
Ko miin woni jiytuɗo laamu Saba’, jogiiɗo ɓataake noddaango ummoraade e annabi-laamɗo dokkuɗo laamu e dow henndu.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Bilqis ari ko e ɗooftaade ñaawirdu Suleymaan
Firaawna e konu mum njolii e nder maayo
Yimɓe Aad halkii e henndu bonndu
Siorooɓe Firaawna ina ngoongɗini Annabi Muusaa
outcome.answer: Bilqis ari ko e ɗooftaade ñaawirdu Suleymaan

arabic: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verse: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars. (27:27)
